comments.body:
Quest name: Habitat of Pearl Oysters
Quest location: Lima Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r15 Recognition, r17 Geography, Oceanic languages
Reward: 1380/690 exp, 522k ducats, 85 cultural contribution (if on correct union)

As with other r17 quests, it requires the appropriate Boston Academy skill for it to appear. In this case, Cartographer's Growth I
